answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1157 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the glacier. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the jetty queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Verification alone takes 11 days each. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
